central_dramatic_question: can a protagonist who learned that visibility is dangerous become publicly seen without surrendering authorship or accepting shallow approval?
protagonist_need_arc: from protected invisibility to chosen visibility grounded in authorship, competence, consent, and reciprocal recognition

sequences.function: future-pressure loop hook, public misreading, and protection-wound contract
sequences.turn: a fragment of the future performance/casting pressure plays before the story cuts back to the original public humiliation
sequences.protagonist_choice: protect a vulnerable person or preserve a small dignity boundary while the crowd misreads her
sequences.new_capability_or_clue: scratched rescue whistle is introduced as the private object/space where the protagonist still authors herself
sequences.ally_or_relationship_change: the first bond is behavioral protection before admiration
sequences.secret_reveal_escalation: the family protection system is part of the wound, not merely a sad backstory
sequences.visual_setpiece: future performance fragment intercut with the tiled pool gallery where students once replayed the humiliating clip and later watch the final drill spectatorship and the private object space
sequences.sound_design_intent: a polished future-performance sound fragment collapses into phone noise, crowd murmur, breath, and object texture
sequences.retention_hook: why does the future need the person everyone is trained not to see?

sequences.function: false rescue, social annihilation, and family accountability
sequences.turn: kindness is publicly reinterpreted as nothing or turned against the protagonist, confirming that being seen means being misjudged
sequences.protagonist_choice: stop performing for the crowd and tell the family what the protection strategy has cost
sequences.new_capability_or_clue: her father taught her to hide the scar and avoid cameras because his own rescue career ended in public blame
sequences.ally_or_relationship_change: a caregiver admits that protective control caused harm instead of only comforting the victim
sequences.secret_reveal_escalation: the protagonist's shame is a learned survival system rather than truth about her worth
sequences.emotional_shift: romantic hope to maximum self-erasure, then permission to change
sequences.visual_setpiece: public crowd geometry repeated at close range, then home objects/mirror/food/scar/ritual evidence of the family system
sequences.sound_design_intent: crowd noise thins into domestic silence and difficult breathing rather than swelling consolation music
sequences.retention_hook: can transformation begin as permission rather than self-hatred?

sequences.function: behavioral transformation cost and first self-authorship
sequences.turn: the protagonist chooses change through training, craft, speech, movement, certification, or authorship rather than instant cosmetic reward
sequences.protagonist_choice: continue the costly transformation practice after failure because it serves self-authorship
sequences.new_capability_or_clue: breath training, scar exposure, rescue certification, and learning to command a room rather than chasing beauty approval
sequences.ally_or_relationship_change: the family/care network supports autonomy rather than controlling appearance
sequences.secret_reveal_escalation: someone has already witnessed her courage before the visible change
sequences.visual_setpiece: repeated practice, body/skill labor, mirror hesitation, object use, and threshold-crossing over time
sequences.sound_design_intent: breath, repetitive training rhythm, room tone, and sparse encouragement replace montage gloss
sequences.retention_hook: will the new self survive re-entry into the same public space?

sequences.function: gaze inversion and morally suspect attention
sequences.turn: the same crowd now admires the protagonist without recognizing the person it previously humiliated
sequences.protagonist_choice: walk through the space upright without forgiving or trusting the crowd's shallow reversal
sequences.new_capability_or_clue: attention is not proof of worth; it is a reversal of social power
sequences.ally_or_relationship_change: the love interest reacts differently because he already knows who she was before visibility
sequences.secret_reveal_escalation: Eren knows Noa stayed underwater with a panicking child when no camera was recording and trusts that act more than appearance
sequences.emotional_shift: fear of being seen to suspicion of being desired
sequences.visual_setpiece: the tiled pool gallery where students once replayed the humiliating clip and later watch the final drill repeated with frozen onlookers, phones, whispers, threshold crossing, and upright movement
sequences.sound_design_intent: crowd murmur swells then drops into close footsteps/breath at the decisive threshold
sequences.retention_hook: if they knew who she was before, would they still look at her this way?

sequences.function: second performance/professional engine opens after the first transformation payoff
sequences.turn: a training documentary about real rescue swimming that turns performance into dangerous physical competence
sequences.protagonist_choice: enter an arena where she must perform visibility rather than merely receive admiration
sequences.new_capability_or_clue: the rival treats the role/public image as property and begins procedural interference
sequences.ally_or_relationship_change: the love interest becomes a working partner rather than a rescuer
sequences.secret_reveal_escalation: the director/coach/institution sees authorship or competence the crowd only consumes as image
sequences.visual_setpiece: audition/training/rehearsal spaces, camera or drill machinery, public spectators, and the protagonist visibly unprepared but capable
sequences.sound_design_intent: institutional instructions, camera/pool/stage machinery, countdowns, and withheld music
sequences.retention_hook: can she perform being seen without losing control of herself?

sequences.function: agency violation, protective intimacy, and danger setpiece
sequences.turn: the coach and Eren enter Noa into the documentary without asking after seeing her secret practice footage; the objection is real even though the opportunity is attractive
sequences.protagonist_choice: continue only after reclaiming consent and boundaries rather than accepting arranged visibility
sequences.new_capability_or_clue: rival interference turns public image pressure into physical or professional danger
sequences.ally_or_relationship_change: Eren, a quiet safety diver who saw Noa keep a younger swimmer alive before the viral clip made her a joke protects the person before the transformation because Eren knows Noa stayed underwater with a panicking child when no camera was recording and trusts that act more than appearance protects through respect, timing, and practical action rather than ownership
sequences.secret_reveal_escalation: the pre-transformation rescue/witness truth begins surfacing
sequences.visual_setpiece: rehearsal/training danger, water/stage/camera machinery, improvised protection, and boundaries visible in blocking
sequences.sound_design_intent: lower loudness, higher negative space, fewer words, and faster cutting during the danger peak
sequences.retention_hook: is protection love if it began by taking away her choice?

sequences.function: reciprocal memory debt and real confession beneath performance
sequences.turn: as children Noa pulled Eren away from a suction grate and told him to breathe before she knew who he was
sequences.protagonist_choice: accept love only after separating gratitude from desire and performance from truth
sequences.new_capability_or_clue: the protagonist learns that her pre-transformation courage, not the transformation, made her unforgettable
sequences.ally_or_relationship_change: romance becomes reciprocal recognition rather than rescue debt
sequences.secret_reveal_escalation: the rival interprets loss as annihilation and escalates toward irreversible exposure/violence
sequences.visual_setpiece: quiet rehearsal/performance two-shot where staged intimacy is mistaken for fiction, then explicitly claimed as real
sequences.sound_design_intent: scene noise drops away; breath and close voice carry more weight than score
sequences.retention_hook: what was real once the performance ends?

sequences.function: public-space reversal, institutional consequence, and chosen visibility closure
sequences.turn: the rival's final attempt to annihilate visibility fails; the protagonist fights back and receives support without surrendering agency
sequences.protagonist_choice: step into the original public space as author/leader rather than object of attention
sequences.new_capability_or_clue: scratched rescue whistle returns openly as the tool of authorship, coordination, or self-claiming
sequences.ally_or_relationship_change: family, institution, and partner repair conduct through public support and consequence rather than private apology alone
sequences.secret_reveal_escalation: visibility is no longer the crowd's gift; it is the protagonist's chosen action
sequences.emotional_shift: defensive survival to chosen public belonging
sequences.visual_setpiece: the pool gallery changes from replay-screen humiliation to a safety community where Noa instructs others openly
sequences.sound_design_intent: crowd sound returns but no longer overwhelms the close voice/breath/object signature
sequences.retention_hook: the ending answers the opening gaze wound through chosen authorship, not applause alone

midpoint_reversal: the first transformation payoff reverses into a second performance arena where visibility must become competence and consent

ending_payoff.justice: the rival loses control of the public image through consequence while the protagonist gains authorship, consent, and chosen visibility rather than applause alone
ending_payoff.belonging: the pool gallery changes from replay-screen humiliation to a safety community where Noa instructs others openly
ending_payoff.future_image: the protagonist's capability becomes public work/legacy, while scratched rescue whistle remains visible as transformed proof rather than nostalgia

anti_patterns_checked: wealth or romance does not replace protagonist agency
hidden power/status creates relational consequences rather than instant reward
proof chain is seeded before the reversal
opening spatial wound returns transformed in the ending
